clauses.title: Conductor Resistance
clauses.content: The electrical resistance of conductors shall not exceed the values specified in IS 8130 for annealed copper and aluminium.

clauses.title: Insulation Resistance & Spark Test
clauses.content: Cables shall pass spark testing at 6 kV AC or 9 kV DC during extrusion without insulation puncture.
